protocol.scope: Noncovalent heterobifunctional PROTAC ternaries; complete heavy-atom identities; one representative copy per PDB entry
protocol.split_unit: Target-family and whole-ligand Bemis-Murcko scaffold groups; common E3-binding substructures do not alone define a scaffold group
protocol.gpu_comparison: Separate track only after measured memory checks; fixed hardware and identical time budget for compared methods
protocol.selection: Report original rank success@1/5/10 and oracle separately; add cluster representatives as a separate endpoint after clustering exists
protocol.chemical_criteria: PoseBusters 0.6.5 mol_fast plus defined tetrahedral/double-bond stereo; typed heavy-atom intercomponent d < 0.75*(r1+r2) counts must be zero
protocol.denominator: Every eligible system, including preparation failures, timeouts and no feasible candidate; report missing assessment coverage separately
protocol.test_policy: No prediction runs, tuning, head selection based on performance or rank inspection on test groups until pipeline freeze. Reference metadata and completeness may be curated now.
protocol.uncertainty: Paired per-system results and group-level intervals; do not treat copies or conformers as independent systems
protocol.readiness: Structural inventory and split assignments frozen. Runnable P1 inputs, complete head/linker definitions and independent binary/apo sources remain to be curated before a full benchmark execution.
